title: Ciarán joins Sifted Webinar on Global Growth in The Age of AI
body_markdown:
🚀 **Coming Up: Global Growth in the Age of AI** 🚀


‍


Our very own CPTO, **Ciarán O’Mara** , will be taking the virtual stage with[@Sifted](https://sifted.eu/) to dive deep into the complexities of scaling a startup in the AI era.


Scaling fast is the goal, but scaling *smart* is the challenge. Join Ciarán and a panel of experts as they discuss balancing speed, risk, and opportunity in a global market.


‍


📅 **Tuesday, April 21 | 12:00 BST**


**‍** 🔗[Register for free here](https://sifted.eu/talks/global-growth-in-the-age-of-ai-balancing-speed-risk-and-opportunity)
